tool_input.content:
SELECT label,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  AVG(f1) AS f1_avg, STDDEV(f1) AS f1_sd, MIN(f1) AS f1_min, MAX(f1) AS f1_max,
  AVG(f2) AS f2_avg, STDDEV(f2) AS f2_sd, MIN(f2) AS f2_min, MAX(f2) AS f2_max,
  AVG(f3) AS f3_avg, STDDEV(f3) AS f3_sd, MIN(f3) AS f3_min, MAX(f3) AS f3_max,
  AVG(f4) AS f4_avg, STDDEV(f4) AS f4_sd, MIN(f4) AS f4_min, MAX(f4) AS f4_max,
  AVG(f5) AS f5_avg, STDDEV(f5) AS f5_sd, MIN(f5) AS f5_min, MAX(f5) AS f5_max,
  AVG(f6) AS f6_avg, STDDEV(f6) AS f6_sd, MIN(f6) AS f6_min, MAX(f6) AS f6_max
FROM leak_data_1
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY label
